sources.title: Google users are less likely to click on links when an AI summary appears in the results

concepts.definition: Creating and distributing valuable, relevant content for a defined audience in order to support a business goal.
Channels a company controls, such as its website and email list.

questions.q: Why does content marketing aim to move an audience to owned media?
questions.a: Because platforms the company does not control can change their rules or algorithms, while an owned channel such as an email list stays reachable.

questions.q: How does a content piece differ from an advertisement?
questions.a: A content piece has value for the reader even without the product, while an advertisement interrupts to deliver the seller's message.

questions.q: In the 2025 Pew analysis, how often did users click a result link with and without an AI summary?
questions.a: On 8% of visits with an AI summary and on 15% without one.
